Background

class Background(settings)[source]

Bases: object

Render the game background, road and sprites.

Parameters:
settingsGameSettings

Game configuration (injected).

Attributes:
settingsGameSettings

Game configuration.

themeKarTEATheme

Track colors from the player’s palette.

clockpygame.time.Clock

Pygame clock.

last_time, time_leftfloat

Timestamps taken at creation.

dtfloat

Delta time placeholder (0).

sprite_tree_left, sprite_tree_rightpygame.Surface

Environment images placed beside the road.

background_imagepygame.Surface

Horizon image scaled to the screen height (aspect ratio kept).

background_surfacepygame.Surface

Horizon image tiled to cover the screen width with a margin.

background_rectpygame.Rect

Position of background_surface.

menu_imagepygame.Surface | None

Menu background, loaded by background_menu.

lineslist[Line]

The 5000 lines of the road.

line_countint

Number of lines.

posfloat

Road position (advances with delta time).

last_start_posint | None

start_pos of the previous frame (see _handle_passed_lines).

player_x, player_yint

Camera lateral position and height.

speedfloat

Road speed, in units per real second.

Notes

The horizon image has a fixed native size and does not follow the screen resolution. It is scaled to the screen height and tiled as many times as needed, so no black bands appear vertically or on wide screens (e.g. Full HD).

set_speed_level(level)[source]

Set the road speed from the arrival time.

The speed (units per real SECOND, applied in draw() with delta_time) is computed so that an object takes settings.OBJECT_ARRIVAL_TIME[level] seconds between appearing on the road and reaching the front of the car, on any machine and FPS.

Parameters:
levelint

Speed 1 (levels 1-2), 2 (levels 3-4) or 3 (levels 5-7).

speed1()[source]

Set the slow speed (levels 1-2).

speed2()[source]

Set the medium speed (levels 3-4).

speed3()[source]

Set the fast speed (levels 5-7).

Stop the road movement.

Returns:
int

OBJECT_SPAWN_SEGMENTS lines ahead of the current position, wrapped around the road length.

draw(surface, delta_time=0.0)[source]

Draw the background, the road and the sprites.

Parameters:
surfacepygame.Surface

Surface drawn on.

delta_timefloat, optional

Real time (s) since the previous frame (GameState.delta_time). With 0 the road does not advance (e.g. menu background).

Notes

The road advances by real elapsed time, not per frame, so it moves at the same speed in real seconds whatever FPS is achieved. The road loops after the last line. Lines behind the camera are not projected or drawn; each trapezoid joins the previous line projected in THIS frame to the current one.

x2, y2, w2int
